callLines.text: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Talia Olsen and Zoe Khan will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Closer bonds with Emberhold could bring more volunteers. For now, these are the people they can spare.
— Stonebridge answers! Omar Weber and Andre Sato will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
Closer bonds with Stonebridge could bring more volunteers. For now, these are the people they can spare.
— Thornfield REFUSES. debts unpaid between you. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)

commit1Lines.text: No one is free to march — every able body is away, engaged, or already committed. THE HERALD waits. The coalition will have to be enough.
